question: How can I find KES 5,000 more a month?
headline: To find KES 5,000 a month, do the first idea below: together worth about KES 5,832 a month. Start with: Check where the Beef went: 1.7 kg more was used than your sales explain.

rows.label: Check where the Beef went: 1.7 kg more was used than your sales explain
rows.action: Check where the Beef went: 1.7 kg more was used than your sales explain
rows.why: In the last 7 days the kitchen used 7.5 kg of Beef; the dishes sold explain 5.8 kg. That is 29% more. A reason to check the store and the portions, not a finding about anyone.

rows.label: Reprice: set Quarter chicken to KES 435 (from KES 400)
rows.action: Reprice: set Quarter chicken to KES 435 (from KES 400)

rows.label: Look at Tuesday evening: the cash has been short 4 of the last 4 times
rows.action: Look at Tuesday evening: the cash has been short 4 of the last 4 times
rows.why: Tuesday evening came up short 4 of the last 4 times, by about KES 491 each time. A repeating gap is a reason to look at how that shift is counted and run, not a finding about anyone.

rows.label: Raise Burger on Glovo to KES 800 (from KES 600)
rows.action: Raise Burger on Glovo to KES 800 (from KES 600)
rows.why: Glovo takes 25%, so a Burger sold there keeps KES 170 instead of KES 320 in the restaurant; 14 sold through Glovo in the last 30 days.

rows.label: Check the till price for Chips: it was charged KES 270 against KES 300 on the menu
rows.action: Check the till price for Chips: it was charged KES 270 against KES 300 on the menu
rows.why: 31 orders in the last 14 days charged 10% less than the menu price. Look at discounts, price changes and open-price items. A reason to check the till, not a finding about anyone.

assumptions.text: Each figure is an estimate of what the idea is worth in a month, worked out from your own sales; it is not a promise.
The ideas are added up in the order Home shows them: what is happening now, money already going out, then money you could make.
